expectationBasis: The evaluation seed contains the seeded workbook `Q3 Sales`, worksheet `Sheet1`, and cell A1 value `Region`
Each record displays "Last updated: <last updated value>" and provides a link whose accessible name is the workbook name.

Worksheet tabs on the same editor page use the ARIA tab role, with the active tab indicated by aria-selected="true"; the active worksheet grid uses the ARIA grid role, has the accessible name "Worksheet grid", and exposes aria-multiselectable="true".

uncoveredOutcomes.reason: The WHEN opens an existing seeded workbook with no invalid or unauthorized input, so no validation or permission failure is triggered and no error-beside-control element is observable in this success path.

No create or write operation is performed, so the conditional partial-record failure mode cannot occur; the seeded workbook remaining intact is covered by the success-path assertions but 'do not create a partial record' is not independently observable.
The same success path does not trigger a failure, so the conditional outcome 'on failure, the original seeded state remains unchanged' cannot be exercised or observed.
